trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001.

- **Cause:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open, and the on-call engineer was paged. It describes the failure and the rollback, and adds a follow-up to find what broke in v2.3.1 before deploying it again. The first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that nothing had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key so it couldn't open a duplicate.
